They also want to calculate the cost from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024, business class. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what about booking? We might need to book flight? The user says "arrange a flight" but also "check different options". They want to compute cost. So maybe we just compute cost. But they also want to provide estimated total payable amount. That could include insurance? Not specified. So just cost.

We need to call get_flight_cost. But we need travel_from and travel_to. We need to get list of airports. So call list_all_airports. Then parse result. Then call get_flight_cost. Then respond with cost.

We don't have access token yet. But get_flight_cost doesn't require auth. So fine.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then respond.
